verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order and grouping: headline, subcopy and fine print sit in one column, with the CTA next to it and the product plus purple circle on the right. Its flaws: the column is centred instead of the original's left alignment, the oversized CTA competes with the headline, the fine print sits tight to the bottom edge, and the circle is clipped at the top-right edge. B breaks the design into scattered pieces. '20% off' sits inside a circle that is cut off at the bottom-left, 'Every mixed case.' floats away from the headline, and the fine print is stranded on the far right. The order jumps from badge to subcopy to CTA and then back to the headline, so there is no grid or clear hierarchy.
